notice.title: Windows 10/11 app launch issues reported
notice.content: Users are reporting that they are unable to launch the app - find out more here.
notice.full_content:
We're aware an issue where Microsoft Endpoint Protection and Smart App Control are blocking launches of our app. This has been reported to Microsoft asa false-positive and we are awaiting registration with SignPath so we can sign our builds and avoid these false-positives in the future.
A temporary workaround is to Open Settings > Privacy and Security > Windows Security > App and Browser control > Smart App Control > Off. This will allow you to open the app.
If Windows or Edge don't let you download Updater CE, simply click more options then Keep, if you have time, can you please [Report the download as safe to Microsoft](https://feedback.smartscreen.microsoft.com/feedback.aspx?url=https%3A%2F%2Frelease-assets.githubusercontent.com%2Fgithub-production-release-asset%2F1039151510%2F96311574-ecdc-465c-a387-1d0c130bd8cd%3Fsp%3Dr%26sv%3D2018-11-09%26sr%3Db%26spr%3Dhttps%26se%3D2026-11-07T20%253A16%253A26Z%26rscd%3Dattachment%253B%2Bfilename%253Dinstaller.exe%26rsct%3Dapplication%252Foctet-stream%26skoid%3D96c2d410-5711-43a1-aedd-ab1947aa7ab0%26sktid%3D398a6654-997b-47e9-b12b-9515b896b4de%26skt%3D2026-11-07T19%253A15%253A55Z%26ske%3D2026-11-07T20%253A16%253A26Z%26sks%3Db%26skv%3D2018-11-09%26sig%3DdmAF6%252BUVEHkd5PYp3yuY5Cjbz3t7luq8B10aZME5h58%253D%26jwt%3DeyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJnaXRodWIuY29tIiwiYXVkIjoicmVsZWFzZS1hc3NldHMuZ2l0aHVidXNlcmNvbnRlbnQuY29tIiwia2V5Ijoia2V5MSIsImV4cCI6MTc5NDA4Mzc2NiwibmJmIjoxNzk0MDgwMTY2LCJwYXRoIjoicmVsZWFzZWFzc2V0cHJvZHVjdGlvbi5ibG9iLmNvcmUud2luZG93cy5uZXQifQ.0iFFB5PDmMYvwpT5_urLq69d9gqJXaYwAgiR8AvAW4o%26response-content-disposition%3Dattachment%253B%2520filename%253Dinstaller.exe%26response-content-type%3Dapplication%252Foctet-stream)
When we're not being blocked by Microsoft anymore (we'll let you know via the app and this website) you can (and should) re-enable Smart App Control when this is resolved and we're no longer being blocked by Microsoft you'll need to follow these steps:
1. Press Windows Key + R, type regedit, and press Enter to open the Registry Editor as an administrator. 2. Navigate to the following path by pasting it into the top address bar: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CI\Policy (Note: On some systems, the folder may be named Policies instead of Policy) 3. Locate the value named VerifiedAndReputablePolicyState in the right-hand pane. 4. Double-click VerifiedAndReputablePolicyState and change its Value data to: • 1 = On (Enforced) • 2 = Evaluation Mode 5. Click OK, close the Registry Editor, and restart your computer.
